source.source_locator: 教則 第3章 3.1.2(3)2)a「飛行計画の通報等」（教則表示ページ23 / PDF viewer 28）

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 特定飛行の飛行計画には、機体・操縦者・運航・立入管理・保険等の所定事項を含めて通報する。
evidence.tested_misconception: 特定飛行の通報は飛行日時と経路だけ入力すれば足りる。
evidence.reasoning_path: specific flight -> notification requirement -> assemble required operational and risk-control fields

collision.note: Tier A。Q053は通報後の計画遵守、Q110は通報時期を問う。通報すべき情報セット自体は未出。

independent_review.rationale: 3.1.2(3)2)a explicitly enumerates the information required in a specific-flight plan notification, including aircraft/pilot, operation, access-control and insurance information. Q053 tests adherence after notification and Q110 notification timing, not the required data set.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the quality-preserving 400-question contract to the B7 Chapter 3 Rules set. All 15 Tier A candidates test explicit source propositions not represented by the current 215-question accepted/source-verified canonical bank. The five Tier B candidates C001, C003, C008, C013 and C015 remain materially distinct through source-defined flight-phase, authority/exception, operation-subtype, response-sequence or moving-vehicle boundaries. None is retained as wording-only variation, none relies on a subsection marked 〔一等〕, and none is accepted merely to fill a numeric quota.
